prompt:
One single new transparent PNG sprite sheet. 3:2 landscape, exactly six equally spaced columns by three equal rows, 18 complete coherent full-body sprites for a 2D slightly top-down orthographic pixel-art RPG. References show the exact same protagonist from the side, front, and back. Preserve his recognizable head, slightly large but proportional, his navy blue short zip jacket and cream T-shirt, dark jeans, navy backpack, blue/cream sneakers, and clustered sharp colored pixels. All 18 sprites fully re-generated from the crown down through the toes, no detached parts. Align every pose to the same centerline and a common bottom ground line within its cell. Identical outfit, visual scale, head size and camera. Entire image transparent between sprites, empty gutters, zero shadows or text. 
Top row side WALK, all six sprites in strict right-facing profile. Pose 1 near foot ahead heel contact and near arm back; Pose 2 near leg almost straight directly under hip and far heel rising behind, far hand swinging forward beyond chest; Pose 3 near support leg still straight with its entire shoe planted, far knee flexes and moves forward, far arm returns from front; Pose 4 far foot ahead heel contact and near arm clearly swings in front of torso; Pose 5 far leg almost straight under hip and near heel rising behind; Pose 6 far support leg still straight and planted, near bent knee comes forward, far arm swung backward. Exactly one straight bearing leg in each passing pose. Natural relaxed hands, opposite-arm swing, small gentle lift of head and shoulders with the intact pose.
Middle row walks toward camera, exact front in all six, fixed position. Precise symmetry of opposite half-cycles is critical. Poses 1 and 4 are same stride but opposite legs, 2 and 5 are same load but opposite legs, 3 and 6 are same passing but opposite legs. In column 1 the viewer-LEFT shoe is nearer the bottom, in column 2 it is planted near the bottom and the viewer-RIGHT shoe is visibly lifted behind it, in column 3 viewer-LEFT shoe is planted and viewer-RIGHT knee swings through. In column 4 viewer-RIGHT shoe steps forward nearer bottom, in column 5 viewer-RIGHT shoe is planted and viewer-LEFT shoe lifts behind, in column 6 viewer-RIGHT shoe is planted and viewer-LEFT knee swings through. Draw visible opposite sleeves following foot rhythm and no sideways gait.
Bottom row walks away from camera, exact back in all six, fixed position. Poses 1 through 3 center the weight on one straight leg and show the OTHER heel rising and passing; poses 4 through 6 swap both legs and swinging arms to repeat the same gait with opposite feet. Show the far heel lift and shoe sole as it kicks back gently without making a running motion. Arm swing easy to read on both sides of the backpack. Match middle row proportions and consistent orthographic camera.
Make the steps visibly different from each other, naturally balanced, with natural but very subtle whole-body rise and fall. Slow ordinary walk. Keep outline thickness consistent. Crisp colored square pixels without softness; no glows or shadows. Uniformly spaced exact six by three rectangular grid with no printed grid lines.
